trajectory of

  • CURIE: gmeow:trajectoryOf
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/trajectoryOf
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/places

The entity whose space-time path this trajectory describes. Functional: a trajectory belongs to exactly one entity.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Trajectory -> gmeow:Entity; functional

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:trajectoryOf from gmeow:Trajectory to gmeow:Entity when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:Trajectory, gmeow:Entity
